test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'DEER' is written as 'EGHV' and 'ROOM' is written as 'SQRQ'. How will 'SOAP' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, 'DEER' is written as 'EGHV',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/600d2e47e42d33dc323591fd8afaea2c9a5e489e7bef9cdd04199de721dba4a0.png] 

For, 'ROOM' is written as 'SQRQ',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f36655e05c45a02420e0cea4a8dca09902df37031c53dc0345a3306f4ccaf599.png] 

Similarly, for '**SOAP**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/357f9cf56bc6cdbadbf2dc215450621720a2ea5a4f4442c20b3992e8894cd57c.png] 

So, '**SOAP**' is coded as '**TQDT**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
